scope: Bounded enum and scalar Double semantics, original GotoTab and TextColorUtil. TextColorUtil runs real AndroidX core1.17.0 and Android14 android-all primitive graphics implementations on a plain JDK with verification; no Android device, Robolectric runner/shadows, full application, or performance claim. Java reflects GotoTab because its package segment goto is a Java keyword.
